cmd.root.short: Sentient CLI — Development tool for Sentient modules
cmd.root.long:
Sentient CLI is the one development tool to create, maintain
and publish modules in the Sentient ecosystem.

Full lifecycle: init → create → develop → debug → audit → pack → sign → publish.
cmd.root.example:
sentients init
  sentients create module
  sentients connect
  sentients pack blog-manager
  sentients sign blog-manager
  sentients publish blog-manager
  sentients audit
flag.sync_remote: update the remote module metadata before unlinking
label.name: Name
cmd.init.long:
Initializes a new Sentient project by downloading the release
archive of the template protorians/sentients-socle (ZIP) and installing
the dependencies.

The release channel (stable [default], alpha, beta, rc) and the package
manager are detected automatically (bun, pnpm, yarn, npm)
and offered to the user.
init.prompt.name: Project name
init.error.not_dir: %s exists and is not a directory
init.error.exists.fix: Choose a different project name or move the existing directory.
init.prompt.existing: Destination %s already exists and is not empty — how do you want to proceed?
init.choice.clear: Clear the contents of the destination
init.error.remove: could not remove the existing directory
init.error.clear: could not clear the contents of the existing directory
init.error.pm_none: no package manager detected (bun, pnpm, yarn, npm)
init.error.pm_none.fix: Install bun, pnpm, yarn or npm and try again.
init.error.clone.fix: Check your connection and that 'git' is installed.
cmd.create.long:
Creates a new module in external_modules/{domain}/ from the reference
hello-world mockup (renamed with the given identifier), or with the
standardized structure when no mockup is available: manifest.json, index.tsx,
components/, hooks/, services/.

Interactive creation asks for the module domain (reverse-DNS dotted form
like com.organization.domain) then the identifier (kebab-case like
hello-world), the application name, and optional metadata: version (default
0.0.0), icon (lucide-react component), page url (default: the identifier) and
description. The page url drives both the scaffolded src/app/{url}/ page and
the manifest.json uri of the deployed module.

The module's unique UUID token is generated automatically.

On creation, the manifest.json is verified: required modules (requirements)
must exist (external_modules/ or src/modules/), and the dependencies
(dependencies and devDependencies) are resolved with the detected package
manager (bun, pnpm, yarn, npm).

Usage : sentients create module [name] [--domain com.org.app] [--id hello-world]
create.error.too_many: too many arguments — use 'sentients create module [name]'
create.error.no_domain: provide the module domain (com.organization.domain form) via --domain or from the interactive creation
create.error.id_conflict: the positional argument and the --id flag designate two different identifiers
create.flag.mockup: reference module directory to scaffold from (default: embedded hello-world mockup)
create.flag.page_mockup: page.tsx template to scaffold the module page from (default: embedded page mockup)
create.flag.name: application name
create.flag.icon: lucide-react component name for the icon (optional)
create.flag.url: page path inside src/app/<url> (default: the identifier)
create.flag.type: distribution type: INTERNAL or EXTERNAL (default: EXTERNAL)
create.flag.category: store category (ADMINISTRATION, COMMERCIAL, FINANCE, OPERATIONS, COMMUNICATION, DATA, AUTOMATION, SYSTEM; default: SYSTEM)
create.warn.mockup_ignored: ignoring --mockup %s: not a scaffoldable module (missing manifest.json or index.tsx); using the embedded mockup
create.warn.page_mockup_ignored: ignoring --page-mockup %s: file not found; using the embedded page mockup
create.warn.pm_none: no package manager detected (bun, pnpm, yarn, npm); the manifest dependencies (dependencies and devDependencies) are not installed
create.error.requirements_missing: required modules not available (external_modules/ or src/modules/): %s
create.error.requirements_missing.fix: Create the required module(s) first with 'sentients create module', or fix the requirements field of the manifest.json.
cmd.connect.long:
Authenticates the developer with their sentient-connect account
(email + password, MFA supported) and stores the credentials securely
(system keychain).
connect.mfa.non_interactive: this run requires an interactive terminal for MFA verification
connect.mfa.error.fix: The code is incorrect or expired. Check your TOTP app / your recovery (backup) codes.
connect.error.network.fix: Check your internet connection and the availability of sentient-connect. Also check the API URL — the `api.baseUrl` of `sentient-auth` in `app.config.json`, or the `SENTIENT_AUTH_API` environment variable.
cmd.disconnect.long: Removes all stored credentials and disconnects the developer.
disconnect.none: You are not connected — nothing to do.
disconnect.confirm.title: Confirm the disconnection
cmd.auth.long:
Authenticates the developer using the OAuth2 authorization-code flow
with PKCE (RFC 7636): opens the browser on the sentient-auth authorization
endpoint, receives the redirect on a local loopback server, exchanges the code
for tokens, then stores the session securely (system keychain).

The OAuth endpoints come from the 'oauth' entry of 'sentient-auth' in
app.config.json (authorizationEndpoint, tokenEndpoint, revokeEndpoint,
clientId, scopes).

In non-interactive (CI) mode, provide the authorization code via the
SENTIENT_CLI_AUTH_CODE environment variable to skip the browser step.
cmd.pack.long:
Builds a module and creates a compressed .SenMod archive
(moved to .sentients/build/).

The version can be given with an '@' separator (e.g. blog-manager@1.2.0)
to build a specific version; otherwise the manifest version is used.

Without an argument, a selector lets you choose the module.
cmd.sign.long:
Manages Ed25519 digital signatures for modules: generates keys,
signs the .SenMod archives and verifies signatures.

Subcommands:
  sign keygen            Generate an Ed25519 key pair
  sign <module>          Sign a module's .SenMod archive
  sign verify <module>   Verify a module's signature

Without arguments, shows the SHA-256 fingerprint of the public key.
cmd.sign.keygen.long:
Generates an Ed25519 key pair and stores it in the system keychain
(fallback: encrypted file ~/.sentient-cli/signing.enc).

If keys already exist, asks for confirmation before overwriting them
(silent regeneration in non-interactive mode).
cmd.sign.verify.long:
Verifies the validity of a module's .sig file against its
.SenMod archive, using the public key stored in the keychain.
sign.error.no_key: no signing key found in the keychain
sign.error.keygen.fix: Run 'sentients sign keygen' to generate a key pair.
sign.confirm.regenerate: Regenerate the key pair (overwrites the previous keys)
sign.confirm.overwrite: A .sig file already exists, overwrite it
sign.invalid.hint: → The archive may have been tampered with or the verification key is wrong.
sign.error.pack.fix: Run 'sentients pack %s' to build the archive first.
sign.error.sign.fix: Run 'sentients sign %s' to sign the archive.
cmd.publish.short: Publish a module to the store
cmd.publish.long:
Builds and publishes a module to the store via the sentient-connect API.

Checks authentication, validates the manifest, builds the .SenMod archive,
then sends it to the store.
publish.error.not_connected: you must be connected to publish a module
publish.error.audit.fix: Fix the errors and retry, or run 'sentients audit %s'.
publish.error.fix: Check your connection and try again.
publish.error.bump.fix: After a manual version bump (manifest.json), retry or run 'sentients pack %s'.
publish.warn.version_conflict: An identical version already exists on the store: %s
cmd.link.short: Link a local module to a remote module
cmd.link.long:
Links a module created in sentient-connect with the local module (via its token).

Checks authentication, lists the online modules, and associates
the chosen local module with the provided remote token.

In non-interactive (CI) mode, provide the local module and the remote
token as arguments: link <module> <token>.
cmd.unlink.short: Unlink a local module from sentient-connect
cmd.unlink.long:
Unlinks a local module from its counterpart in sentient-connect.
The manifest.json token is replaced with a new local UUID token.

--sync-remote first syncs the local metadata (name, type,
description) to the remote product via PUT /api/developer-store/modules/:id
(best-effort, requires being connected).
link.error.not_connected: you must be connected to link a module
link.error.non_interactive: non-interactive mode requires the local module and the remote token
link.error.no_modules.fix: Publish a module first with 'sentients publish', or provide the token as an argument: 'sentients link <module> <token>'.
link.error.no_token: provide the remote module token as an argument
link.error.remote.fix: The remote token is invalid or the module does not exist.
link.error.none_linked: no modules linked to a remote module found in external_modules
link.error.not_linked: module %q is not linked to a remote module
link.error.multi: multiple linked modules, provide the module name as an argument
link.warn.no_remote: no remote module associated, sync skipped
link.success.synced: ✓ Metadata synced to the remote module
link.unlinked: %s is no longer linked to a remote module.
cmd.debug.short: Debug a module or all modules
cmd.debug.long:
Runs the debug of one (or all) module(s) in external_modules/.

Validates the module, resolves a build command (package.json script,
bundler or TypeScript type-check) and streams its output in real time.
A `debug`/`dev` script is treated as a dev server: it is stopped after
its start window (--timeout) and reported as started.
Press Ctrl+C to cancel at any time.

Without an argument, all modules are debugged.
debug.npm_none: no package manager detected, validation only
debug.no_build_script: no build script (debug/dev/build), bundler (esbuild/tsup) or TypeScript type-check found — validation only
debug.step.resolve.none: no build script, bundler or type-check found
debug.step.build.started: dev script running — stopped after %s (server/watch mode)
debug.flag.timeout: execution window for a debug/dev script, or cap for a build (0 = auto)
cmd.test.short: Run the tests of a module or all modules
cmd.test.long:
Runs the tests of one (or all) module(s) in external_modules/.

Validates the module, resolves a test package with the package manager chosen
at install (bun/pnpm/yarn/npm), installs it within that manager's scope when
needed and streams the suite output in real time. The chosen test package is
persisted in sentients.config.json. The run exits non-zero when any module's
tests fail.
Press Ctrl+C to cancel at any time.

Without an argument, all modules are tested.
test.npm_none: no package manager detected, validation only
test.no_test_script: no test script, runner (vitest/jest) or test files found — validation only
test.step.resolve.none: no test script, runner (vitest/jest) or test files found
test.step.no_tests.detail: no test file found — module skipped
test.no_tests: no test file found in the module — skipped
test.flag.timeout: hard cap for a test run (0 = auto)
test.flag.runner: test package used to run the suite (persisted in sentients.config.json)
cmd.audit.long:
Audits the conformance of one (or all) module(s) against the
Sentient rules: Clean Architecture, manifest.json and index.tsx.

Without an argument, all modules in external_modules/ are audited.
audit.passed: ✓ Audit passed — no errors, no warnings
modules.error.cwd: unable to determine the current directory
modules.error.root.fix: Run 'sentients init' to initialize a Sentient project.
modules.error.module_absent.fix: Check the module name or run 'sentients create module'.
modules.error.multiple: multiple modules available, provide the module name as an argument
tui.summary.title: Summary
module.error.name_length: module name must be between 3 and 64 characters
module.error.name_kebab: module name must be kebab-case (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only)
module.error.domain: module domain must be a reverse-DNS dotted form (e.g. com.organization.domain)
module.error.version: version must follow the SemVer format (e.g. 0.0.0)
module.error.icon: icon must be a PascalCase component name (e.g. PuzzleIcon)
module.error.type: type must be INTERNAL or EXTERNAL
module.error.category: invalid category (allowed: ADMINISTRATION, COMMERCIAL, FINANCE, OPERATIONS, COMMUNICATION, DATA, AUTOMATION, SYSTEM)
pack.error.validation: module %q has %d validation error(s), packaging aborted
pack.error.max_size: archive exceeds the maximum size of %d MB
auth.error.no_token: no session token available — run 'sentients connect'
auth.oauth.open_browser: Opening the authorization page in your browser…
auth.oauth.error.state: state mismatch — the authorization response could not be verified
auth.oauth.error.exchange.fix: Retry 'sentients auth' and complete the authorization in the browser.
auth.oauth.non_interactive.fix: Provide the code via SENTIENT_CLI_AUTH_CODE in non-interactive mode.
